$description: Responsive breakpoints for the 'adminlte-classic' template (Classic Admin). Obtained by observing the public visual identity of AdminLTE, which follows Bootstrap 5's standard responsive scale. The side navigation collapses into a collapsed/off-canvas menu below the 'lg' breakpoint. Original document — see ATTRIBUTION.md.

lg.$description: 992px — the point at which the sidebar stops being fixed/expanded and starts behaving as off-canvas.
